scope.supported: leaf images captured in a studio or against a plain, controlled background
not_supported_claims: species outside the six registered classes
capture_guidance: Use a single clearly visible leaf or plant.
Use a plain background and even lighting.
Avoid mixed plant species in one upload batch.

selection.decision: V1 is retained as the final integration baseline because it has the highest minimum per-class recall in the common controlled-domain diagnostic, an already verified runtime and frozen-threshold chain, and no model-binary migration is required. V2 has the highest Macro-F1 on this overused validation set, but the small difference is insufficient to prove superiority on an independent blind set.
selection.claim: final integration baseline; not proven globally most accurate

limitations: No new independent blind controlled-background set was available for final model selection.
The common validation set was used previously and is dominated by rose images.
The reported metrics apply only to the controlled-background evaluation domain.
The classifier does not identify unsupported/OOD plants reliably.
Natural-scene performance must not be inferred from these metrics.
A confidence score is a model score and is not a laboratory or botanical confirmation.
